item.name: Live burn rate, session cost so far, and org runway for a VM

request.description: Every VM bills at one bundled hourly rate (per-GPU catalog price times GPU count for GPU VMs, a flat size rate for CPU VMs); disk is included, never billed separately. The rate is locked when the usage session opens, so this endpoint reads it from the open usage record when one exists (rateSource=locked) and only falls back to the current catalog when nothing is accruing (rateSource=catalog).
